company.name: Maze Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Maze Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that develops precision medicines for renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases.
company.description: Maze Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing medicines that mimic the effects of rare, protective genetic variants to address unmet medical needs. Utilizing its Compass platform, the company identifies genetic variants associated with diseases and maps them to the biological pathways driving these conditions in specific patient populations.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Maze Therapeutics is engaged in developing inhibitors targeting solute carrier family 6a member 19 (SLC6A19) and apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1), as described in titles such as 'Inhibitors of solute carrier family 6a member 19 (slc6a19) and methods of use' and 'Apol1 inhibitors and methods of use.' Abstracts detail the synthesis and application of these compounds, with additional focus on glycogen synthase 1 (GYS1) inhibitors. These efforts address renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases.
